title: Bounded-fan-out equivalent circuit
statement: Let $C$ be a finite Boolean circuit in which every gate has distinct arguments and has exactly one argument if it is a NOT gate, and exactly two otherwise; suppose every vertex other than the output has positive fan-out. Then there exists another circuit $C'$ with the same number of inputs such that every gate of $C'$ satisfies those same argument conditions, every vertex has fan-out at most two, $C'$ computes the same Boolean function as $C$ on every input, and the size of $C'$ is at most $20$ times the size of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: Each NOT gate has exactly one argument and each other gate exactly two
Every vertex below the circuit size other than the output has positive fan-out
